capabilities: Compile a workout note from clipboard text
Attach local images and PDFs to each workout item
Prompt for missing schema files and copy them into canonical folders
Route finished notes into per-client subfolders
Build a workout summary card with date, client, level and exercises
disambiguation: Not a fitness tracking or workout scheduling app; it only compiles a note from pasted text and files already in the vault.
extras: README stresses the plugin works fully offline: no Telegram connection, no external server, no uploads, and it never modifies the user's source files. The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Supports PNG, JPG/JPEG, WebP, GIF and PDF up to 25 MB, with one file per workout item; expected folder names and file naming rules are documented in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to compile workout notes from pasted text and match each exercise to locally stored schema images or PDFs.
summary: Turns copied workout text into a structured Markdown note and attaches matching images and PDFs from local vault folders.
